Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Symmetric saddle systems and Schur preconditioning MINRES and GMRES use the same original-system residual criterion and are checked against the ideal Schur three-point spectrum. Assumptions, units and boundaries Algebraic mixed-Poisson/Stokes-type blocks with velocity sizes 12 and 24 and pressure sizes 5 and 11. The common original-system residual tolerance is 1e-9. Editorial clarification A dense, ideal-Schur educational control, not a complete Stokes PDE solver or a scalable approximate preconditioner. Adopted numerical method Stored-basis Lanczos least squares provides the educational MINRES variant; GMRES uses two-pass modified Gram-Schmidt. An SPD congruence preserves symmetry. The internal target is min(configured rtol, fixed forward-error limit / kappa_infinity), using only the matrix. The independent solution is not a stopping input.
